title.en: Kalai Pala Valarththal Eythi (கலை பல வளர்த்தல் எய்தி)

text.en: A lawyer is stirred by a musician's playing late at night.

This is a short-story piece in the arts unit. In the textbook extract a lawyer hears music being played again and again, five or six times, ending as if the sound melted into silence. The story shows how an artist's devotion to his art fills the listener.
The unit's message is that art, music and learning should be developed, and that a true artist loves his art above all.
Terms: கலை (art), இசை (music), கீர்த்தனை (a devotional song) and கலைஞன் (artist). Read the full story in your textbook for the details of the plot.
